title: Schema C: call trees before and after
description: Where the time goes: call trees whose frames carry their own work before and after the change, such as a change's entry points or one query under a given load. Read by style 4, the differential icicle. Rust type: rain_lab::schema::calls::CallTrees.

calls.description: The call tree under the change's entry points; the icicle's first tab.

profiles.description: More call trees to compare, one tab each.

title.description: What was measured and under what load; the tab's label.

id.description: Unique across every tree in the document; a pick names it.

before.description: Its own work before the change, in milliseconds per request; 0 for a new call.

after.description: Its own work after the change; 0 for a call that is gone.
